title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“王大年，你小子也别怨我。”“这可是你自己选的。”“我已经不止一次问过你了。”“你可是说你就要95式自动步枪的。”杨成看见王大年那副表情，也是一脸的恨铁不成钢的表情。原本王大年也算是自己手底下作战能力突出的悍将了。可这王大年自己非得选95式自动步枪，这也怪不得自己了。“行了，接下来我来详细给你们两个讲讲如何使用pf89式火箭筒。”杨成也没有时间再啰嗦，直接转过头对着一脸振奋的冯元彪和另外一名士兵说道。那名被王大年抢枪的士兵，杨成是认识的。他没有名字，当初加入大夏国东北军之后。就一直被杨成安排在王大年的麾下。小五子的年龄只有十六岁出头。算是自己这帮人中最小的。可别看小五子年纪小，真正打起仗来。比自己手底下的一些老兵都还要凶悍。昨天伏击倭军小队时，小五子可是单对单干掉了一名倭军士兵。这也是杨成为何放心将一支pf89式火箭筒交给他的缘故。在杨成给二人讲解的时候，冯元彪和小五子二人都听得十分认真。生怕漏听了杨成话语当中哪怕一个字。很快，冯元彪和小五子摆弄起pf89式火箭筒，也逐渐得心应手了起来。就在这时。一个身上插满了树叶，手里拎着一把三八大盖的哨兵。从黑风寨的寨门外，快步地朝着众人所在的位置跑了过来。当哨兵来到黑虎堂前的校场。看到校场四周弟兄手里的家伙什，脸上表情一愣。不过，仅仅愣神了片刻。哨兵还是来到了杨成的面前。“大当家，黑虎山南面四公里外发现两股倭军。”“人数大致在三四百人左右，现在正朝着我们这边过来了。”这名哨兵的脸上十分的焦急。显然之前杨成召集所有人分装备的时候，他并没有在场。面对两支成建制的倭军中队。哨兵的内心还是升出了一丝恐惧。“什么？”“还有四公里？”没等杨成说话，王大年倒是先坐不住了。立马从黑虎堂前的台阶上跳了下来。

“还有四公里，这些小鬼子是来黑虎山游山玩水的吗？”“怎么来得这么慢？”冯元彪也是一脸急躁地说道，似乎对倭军的行进速度很是不满。听见王大年和冯元彪的话。哨兵有些不敢相信自己的耳朵。自己刚才是不是幻听了啊？怎么听两位当家的意思，他们还希望倭军早点过来？摇了摇头，哨兵喉结滚动，用力地咽了一口口水。“二当家，三当家，我是说倭军离我们黑虎山仅仅只有四公里了。”“按照这个速度，应该还有一个多小时，就能到咱们这儿了。”哨兵总觉得哪里有些不对劲，再次提醒道。只是王大年和冯元彪脸上的不满丝毫没有褪去。哨兵只得将目光转望向坐在黑虎堂前台阶正中央交椅上的大当家。“来得还是太慢了一些。”“如果不能再快一点，这战估计要打到天黑了。”“这晚饭怕是吃不成了。”当大当家的话音一出。哨兵只觉得整个人脑袋有些晕乎乎的。这个世界到底怎么了？怎么感觉黑风寨的这些个掌舵人个个都有些不太正常？没等哨兵从惊讶当中反应过来。扬成从交椅上站了起来，直接拍板道。“传我命令，在小鬼子进黑虎山的路上沿途放空枪。”“把鬼子往山里引。”“大家伙争取在日落之前解决掉这批倭军。”杨成话音一落。哨兵整个人呆住了。还想说些什么，但是那名哨兵这才发现。自己身边的人，准确来说，是这校场中除了自己之外的所有黑风寨弟兄。竟然一个个亢奋不已。这是自己看错了吗？哨兵此刻陷入到了深深的自我怀疑当中。“大当家，我亲自带人去吸引小鬼子。”“保证三十分钟之内，将他们给引进山。”这个时候，王大年直接跳出拍了拍胸脯对着杨成保证道。“行，将鬼子引进山的任务就交给你了。”“其他人迅速进入战斗状态，到各个布防点准备埋伏。”面对王大年的主动请缨，杨成想都没想就答应了下来。
content_en:
"Wang Danian, don't blame me, kid." "This is your choice." "I've asked you more than once." "You said you wanted the Type 95 automatic rifle." When Yang Cheng saw Wang Danian's expression, he also had an expression of hatred for steel.Originally, Wang Danian was considered a warrior with outstanding combat capabilities under his command.But Wang Danian had to choose the Type 95 automatic rifle, and he couldn't blame himself."Okay, let me tell you two in detail how to use the PF89 rocket launcher." Yang Cheng didn't have time to talk anymore, and turned directly to Feng Yuanbiao and another soldier who looked excited.Yang Cheng knew the soldier whose gun was snatched by Wang Danian.He has no name. He initially joined the Northeastern Army of the Great Xia Kingdom.He has been arranged by Yang Cheng to work under Wang Danian.Xiaowuzi is only in his early sixteen years.He is considered the youngest among his group.Don't look at Xiaowuzi's young age and start a real war.More ferocious than some of the veterans under his command.When ambushing a Japanese squad yesterday, Xiaowuzi killed a Japanese soldier one-on-one.This is why Yang Chenghe safely handed over a PF89 rocket launcher to him.When Yang Cheng explained to them, both Feng Yuanbiao and Xiao Wuzi listened very carefully.I was afraid of missing even one word of Yang Cheng's words.Soon, Feng Yuanbiao and Xiao Wuzi started playing with the PF89 rocket launcher, and gradually became more comfortable with it.Just then.A sentry with leaves all over his body and a 38-meter cap in his hand.From outside the gate of Heifeng Village, he quickly ran towards where everyone was.When the sentry came to the school field in front of Black Tiger Hall.Seeing the things in the hands of the brothers around the school grounds, the expressions on their faces were stunned.However, he was stunned for only a moment.The sentry came to Yang Cheng anyway."Master, two groups of Japanese troops were found four kilometers south of Black Tiger Mountain." "The number is about three to four hundred people, and they are coming towards us now." The sentry's face was very anxious.Obviously, he was not present when Yang Cheng called everyone to distribute equipment.Facing two established Japanese army squadrons.There was still a hint of fear in the sentry's heart."What?" "Four kilometers more?" Before Yang Cheng could speak, Wang Danian couldn't sit still.He immediately jumped down from the steps in front of the Black Tiger Hall.

"There are still four kilometers. Are these little devils coming to Black Tiger Mountain for sightseeing?" "Why are they coming so slowly?" Feng Yuanbiao also said impatiently, seeming to be very dissatisfied with the speed of the Japanese army's march.Hear what Wang Danian and Feng Yuanbiao said.The sentry couldn't believe his ears.Did you hallucinate just now?Why do the two masters think that they still hope that the Japanese army will come as soon as possible?Shaking his head, the sentry's Adam's apple rolled and he swallowed hard."Second Master, Third Master, I mean the Japanese army is only four kilometers away from our Black Tiger Mountain." "At this rate, they should be able to reach us in more than an hour." The sentry always felt that something was wrong and reminded him again.But the dissatisfaction on the faces of Wang Danian and Feng Yuanbiao has not faded at all.The sentry had no choice but to turn his gaze to the headmaster who was sitting on the chair in the center of the steps in front of the Black Tiger Hall."It's still too slow." "If we can't hurry up, the battle will probably last until dark." "I'm afraid we won't be able to eat this dinner." The words of the head master came out.The sentry felt a little dizzy.What happened to this world?Why do you feel that all the leaders of Heifeng Village are a little abnormal?Before the sentry could react from his surprise.Yang Cheng stood up from his chair and said directly."Pass my order to fire blank rifles along the way as the Japs enter Black Tiger Mountain." "Lead the Japs into the mountains." "Everyone, try to get rid of these Japanese troops before sunset." Yang Cheng finished his words.The sentry was stunned.He wanted to say something more, but the sentinel just realized it.The people around him, to be precise, are all the Black Wind Village brothers except himself in this school.All of them were extremely excited.Did you see this wrong?The sentinel fell into deep self-doubt at this moment."Master, I will personally lead people to attract the little devils." "I promise to lead them into the mountain within thirty minutes." At this time, Wang Danian jumped out and patted his chest and promised Yang Cheng."Okay, I'll leave the task of bringing the Japs into the mountain to you." "The others quickly entered combat mode and went to various defense points to prepare for ambush." ​​Faced with Wang Danian's offer, Yang Cheng agreed without thinking.
